translations.web: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask of them, can answer a word.
translations.bsb: When I look, there is no one; there is no counselor among them; when I ask them, they have nothing to say.
translations.kjv: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
translations.asv: And when I look, there is no man: even among them there is no counsellor, that, when I ask of them, can answer a word.
